cards.title: Identity of documents
cards.body: IDs come from immutable source identifiers.

cards.title: Access
cards.body: Users and groups indexed first; groups mapped directly; no allow-all on sensitive content.

cards.title: Completeness
cards.body: A full run halts before finalizing on an early empty page or a count anomaly.

cards.title: Freshness and deletion
cards.body: Every object family has a deletion path; checkpoints written on success only.

cards.title: Operations and security
cards.body: Secrets in a store; tokens per environment; alert on sharp drops.
